title: ⚔️ Gales of Gods: Chronicles of Valhalla: a fantasy esports manager made for mobile 📱
author: kronendgames
selftext:
I’ve been working on this for months as a solo dev. It’s designed from the ground up for phones and played in portrait mode. You don’t play the matches: you build the team, run the draft and make the big calls mid-game.

* **Pro-style draft** with 100+ original champions, counters, flex picks and Fearless Bo5 series
* **Live matches on a map** where you decide: contest the drake, split with Teleport or go for the backdoor
* **Full staff**: coaches, draft analysts, psychologist, scout. Their skill affects their advice, and they can be wrong
* **400 clubs in 4 tiers** with promotion and relegation. Found your own club in tier 4 and climb to the top

Android, offline, free, in English and Spanish. Launching on Google Play soon. Feedback very welcome!
